doc:
The full trace family cannot replace the determined traces in
`mk_determined_le_mk_shatters`: the half-line cuts over `ℚ` trace continuum-many sets while
shattering only countably many.
pretty:
¬Cardinal.mk ↑((fun x => Set.univ ∩ x) '' Set.range fun r => {q | ↑q < r}) ≤
    Cardinal.mk ↑{B | B ⊆ Set.univ ∧ Shatters (Set.range fun r => {q | ↑q < r}) B}
